MacroAnnotations.0.Value: The point where sample playback will begin, displayed as a percentage of the sample's length.

MacroAnnotations.1.Value: The length of the sample region which Simpler can play, displayed as a percentage of the sample's length.

MacroAnnotations.2.Value: Switch the playback loop on or off and adjust the length of the loop. 0: Playback loop is off. 1-127: Playback loop is on. The higher the value, the longer the loop length.

MacroAnnotations.3.Value: Global transpose amount, displayed in semitones. Note: Pitch control has no effect if the Slices are warped with Re-Pitch mode.

MacroAnnotations.4.Value: The time needed to travel from the initial level to the Peak value.

MacroAnnotations.5.Value: This is the level reached at the end of the decay stage. The envelope will remain at this level until a note-off is received.

MacroAnnotations.6.Value: Controls both the decay and release times of the amp envelope. Decay time: The time needed to travel from the peak level to the sustain level. Release time: The time needed for the sample to become silent after a note-off message is received.

MacroAnnotations.7.Value: How much the volume of the sample is influenced by the velocity of incoming notes.
